findings.summary: The first-prod-deploy task file pointed to the wrong step numbers for the digest, the secret file and the before-and-after check.
The task file sent by instance tag instead of by instance id, unlike scripts/ci_deploy.py and the README.
The prod-never-touches-dev test matrix has no scenario for a failure at the database step.
The script does not check that a fetched compose.yaml reads STACK_PROJECT, so a send of a digest older than #271 to prod is not guarded.
SECRET_REGION is never read, because the Python secret read names its region itself.
Any job that holds the deploy role can send environment=prod; the decision record names this trade-off, and the deploy-prod reviewer gate is the control.
The first prod send exited 3 because iam-and-budgets had not been re-applied after #268, and neither task file checked the instance role's policy before the send.
The task file's placeholders, its run-folder sentence and its mktemp step led to a literal file named after a placeholder in the repository folder and an empty secret send.
